limitations: Six implementation-authored development cases; two use previously captured public job text and four are synthetic. Both policies use the same current model prompt. Expected routes are not independent human labels. This measures shortlist inclusion and single-step routing, not discovery recall, personal fit, whole-internet coverage, delivery or global scale. Live model calls are bounded separately from the worker ledger; the production planner retains its shared admission policy.
